scope.excluded: No 3.2 model feedback, run logs, result or checkpoint files, provisional comparisons, historical saved model outputs, codex-review-packet, or codex-bilingual-audit were viewed. No provider or paid model tools were called.
scope.checksumAlgorithm: SHA-256 over UTF-8 canonical JSON with sorted keys, no ASCII escaping, and compact separators for each draft label.

summary.rangeAndEvidenceAssessment: All 20 dimension ranges have case-specific transcript support; every evidence quote is a contiguous exact transcript substring and every input checksum matches the packet.
summary.literalFindingAssessment: The two required literals name central technical ideas. The seven forbidden literals address concrete unsupported claims or experience reversals; remaining risks are governed by the contract and case rationale. Literal matching cannot prove semantic correctness.
summary.contentExpressionSeparation: Fluent irrelevant or unsupported responses retain high English-expression ranges. Brief untranslated Chinese clauses affect expression while their underlying ideas still count toward content dimensions.
summary.pending: Independent bilingual semantic review of actual feedback and runtime comparison remain pending.
